attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The change alters core caching behavior in the base ContentElement class (Data setter now also clears the internal Elements dictionary), which is foundational to all ContentItems/ContentParts across every module and tenant, so even though it targets a real stale-cache bug in cloning, unintended side effects could surface broadly wherever cached sub-elements are expected to persist across Data reassignment."}
